# Keyboard shortcuts

<!-- Generated from desktop/src/ui/actions.rs by its tests. Do not edit by hand: run `RYOLUNE_BLESS=1 cargo test -p ryolune shortcuts`. -->

The same list is in the app: Help > Shortcuts and Help (⌘/). ⌘ is Ctrl on Windows and Linux, ⌥ is Alt.

## Transport

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| Play / Stop | `Space` |
| Stop | `0` |
| Record | `R` |
| Cycle | `C` |
| Go to Beginning | `↩` |
| Rewind One Bar | `,` |
| Forward One Bar | `.` |
| Metronome Click | `K` |

## Editing

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| Undo | `⌘Z` |
| Redo | `⇧⌘Z` |
| Delete | `⌫` or `Del` |
| Duplicate Clip | `⌘D` |
| Split Clip at Playhead | `⌘T` |
| Open in Editor | `E` |
| Copy | `⌘C` |
| Cut | `⌘X` |
| Paste at Playhead | `⌘V` |
| Transpose Up a Semitone | `⌥↑` |
| Transpose Down a Semitone | `⌥↓` |
| Transpose Up an Octave | `⌥⇧↑` |
| Transpose Down an Octave | `⌥⇧↓` |

## Tracks

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| New MIDI Track | `⌥⌘S` |
| New Audio Track | `⌥⌘A` |
| Duplicate Track | `⇧⌘D` |
| Delete Track | `⌘⌫` |
| Mute Track | `M` |
| Solo Track | `S` |
| Record-Arm Track | `A` |
| Input Monitoring: Off / Auto / On | `I` |

## View

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| Zoom In | `⌘=` |
| Zoom Out | `⌘-` |
| Zoom to Fit Session | `Z` |
| Follow Playhead | `F` |
| Mixer | `X` |
| Controller Lane | `L` |
| Tempo Track | `⇧T` |
| Pointer Tool | `1` |
| Pencil Tool | `2` |
| Scissors Tool | `3` |
| Command Palette… | `⌘P` |
| Shortcuts and Help | `⌘/` |

## Markers

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| Add Marker at Playhead | `⇧M` |
| Go to Previous Marker | `⇧B` |
| Go to Next Marker | `⇧N` |
| Cycle Section at Playhead | `⇧C` |

## Agent

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| Agent Panel | `⌘J` |
| Ask Agent About Selection… | `⇧⌘J` |

## File

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| New Session | `⌘N` |
| Open… | `⌘O` |
| Save | `⌘S` |
| Save As… | `⇧⌘S` |
| Import Audio… | `⌘I` |
| Export Audio… | `⌘B` |
| Settings… | `⌘,` |
| Musical Typing | `⌘K` |
| Quit ryolune | `⌘Q` |

## Musical typing

With musical typing on (⌘K), the letter row from A to ; plays notes on the selected instrument track, and Z / X shift the octave.
